description.value:
As a minor action on your turn once per long rest, you close your eyes and exhale, putting yourself into a state of self-induced hypnosis. Through a mental technique passed down through generations, you distance yourself from reality in preparation for the violence of combat. As you open your eyes again, you act purely on instinct, becoming @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.Y822OUCDEPAG0HS8]{Frenzied}.
At the end of each turn, you can attempt to make a DC 13 Wisdom (Save) check to end the frenzy.
Frenzied conditions entered this way do not benefit from the Calm Mind racial trait, but also do not break your spell concentration.
